request: Review the consumer handoff and any supplied implementation against the contract. Explain what can be concluded about candidate acceptance and signing. Return one concise structured review record.

artifacts.text: Consumers must revalidate candidate payload bytes against their digest before accepting them, including a candidate modified after construction. Signing is a separate operation requiring verified authority and operator approval. Acceptance alone does not authorize signing.
The producer constructs Candidate(payload, digest) and passes it to consume(candidate). The consumer handoff specifies no byte/hash revalidation step.
The signer implementation is unavailable. Only the supplied consumer probe was executed.
